derivation: from a derivative of G4078 (πήγνυμι) (meaning thick);
def: to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous)

occurrences.text: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
